copy_verified: every destination file re-hashed and compared to its source digest
purpose: Step 0 of PLAN-20260806-niter3-budget-and-J28-reroll: the throw slabs the J28 re-roll and the niter=3 budget recompute both consume. A purge of /pscratch before the re-roll converts a cheap post-hoc rescale into a full re-throw.
readability_check: np.load on every slab with every array materialised; a byte-identical copy of a corrupt npz is still corrupt, so presence and digests alone do not answer this
selection: npz whose FILENAME contains 'slab' OR whose immediate DIRECTORY name does, plus every bank flux_univ_ratio.npy, plus any --extra. The directory clause is load-bearing: block slabs are named block5d_*.npz / blockfps_*.npz and a filename-only filter finds 365 of 542 while still reporting '0 unreadable'. Deliberately EXCLUDED: the banks' per-universe sig_*/td_* arrays (26-37 GB each), which are re-THROW inputs, not inputs to this post-hoc rescale.
